### Évolution de la vaccination au Canada
```{r}
# Chargement des données

#vaccination <- read.csv2(here::here("data", "vaccinationcanada.csv"), sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
vaccination <- read.csv2("data/vaccinationcanada.csv", sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

une_dose <- vaccination[, c("week_end", "prfname", "numtotal_atleast1dose")]
une_dose$week_end <- as.Date(une_dose$week_end)

# Graphique

vaccination_canada <- ggplot(une_dose %>% filter(prfname == "Canada"),
aes(x = week_end, y = numtotal_atleast1dose)) +
geom_line(color = "blue", linewidth = 1) +
geom_point(color = "red") +
labs(
title = "Évolution de la vaccination au Canada",
x = "Date",
y = "Nombre de doses administrées"
) +
theme_minimal()

ggplotly(vaccination_canada)
```

### Graphique interactif par pays

```{r}
# Chargement des données

deaths_for_Covid <- read.csv(here::here("data", "daily-new-confirmed-covid-19-deaths-per-million-people.csv"))
deaths_for_Covid <- deaths_for_Covid %>% rename(
daily_deaths_permillion = Daily.new.confirmed.deaths.due.to.COVID.19.per.million.people..rolling.7.day.average..right.aligned.
)
deaths_for_Covid <- deaths_for_Covid %>% mutate(Day = ymd(Day))

# Interface utilisateur pour choisir les pays

selectInput_pays <- selectInput(
inputId = "pays",
label = "Choisissez un ou plusieurs pays :",
choices = sort(unique(deaths_for_Covid$Entity)),
selected = c("Canada", "China"),
multiple = TRUE
)

output$graph_deces <- renderPlotly({
data_filtre <- deaths_for_Covid %>% filter(Entity %in% input$pays)

p <- ggplot(data_filtre, aes(x = Day, y = daily_deaths_permillion, color = Entity)) +
geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
labs(
title = "Décès COVID-19 par million d'habitants",
x = "Date", y = "Décès journaliers (moyenne 7 jours)"
) +
theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p)
})
```

```{r}
ui <- fluidPage(
  titlePanel("Évolution des décès COVID-19 par pays"),
  
  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      selectInput(
        inputId = "pays",
        label = "Choisissez un ou plusieurs pays :",
        choices = sort(unique(deaths_for_Covid$Entity)),
        selected = c("Canada", "China"),
        multiple = TRUE
      )
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      plotlyOutput("graph_deces", height = "500px")
    )
  )
)

# --- Serveur
server <- function(input, output) {
  output$graph_deces <- renderPlotly({
    data_filtre <- deaths_for_Covid %>% 
      filter(Entity %in% input$pays)
    
    p <- ggplot(data_filtre, aes(x = Day, y = daily_deaths_permillion, color = Entity)) +
      geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
      labs(
        title = "Décès COVID-19 par million d'habitants",
        x = "Date", y = "Décès journaliers (moyenne 7 jours)"
      ) +
      theme_minimal()
    
    ggplotly(p)
  })
}
shinyApp(ui, server)
```

### Pics de décès par pays

```{r}
covid_map <- deaths_for_Covid %>%
filter(!is.na(daily_deaths_permillion)) %>%
filter(Day >= as.Date("2020-01-09") & Day <= as.Date("2025-09-28")) %>%
group_by(Entity) %>%
summarise(max_deaths = max(daily_deaths_permillion, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
ungroup() %>%
filter(!Entity %in% c("Africa", "Asia", "Europe", "European Union (27)", "High-income countries",
"Kosovo", "Low-income countries", "Lower-middle-income countries", "Micronesia (country)",
"North America", "Oceania", "South America", "Upper-middle-income countries",
"World", "World excl. China", "World excl. China and South Korea",
"World excl. China, South Korea, Japan and Singapore")) %>%
mutate(iso_code = countrycode(Entity, "country.name", "iso3c"))

fig_map <- plot_ly(
covid_map,
type = 'choropleth',
locations = ~iso_code,
z = ~max_deaths,
text = ~paste(Entity, "<br>", "Décès max / million:", round(max_deaths, 2)),
colorscale = "Reds",
reversescale = FALSE,
marker = list(line = list(color = "gray", width = 0.3))
) %>%
layout(
title = "Décès journaliers maximaux COVID-19 par million d’habitants (Jan 2020 - Sep 2025)",
geo = list(
showframe = FALSE,
showcoastlines = FALSE,
projection = list(type = 'natural earth')
)
)

fig_map
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# ÉTAPE 1: PRÉPARER LES DONNÉES

Covid19 <- read.csv(here::here("data", "Covid19.csv"))


Covid19$Day <- as.Date(Covid19$Day)
Covid19 <- Covid19 %>% filter(!is.na(Day))
Covid19$Total.confirmed.cases.of.COVID.19 <- as.numeric(as.character(Covid19$Total.confirmed.cases.of.COVID.19))

# Prendre les données les plus récentes par pays

data_latest <- Covid19 %>%
  group_by(Entity) %>%
  filter(Day == max(Day)) %>%  
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Entity, Day, Total.confirmed.cases.of.COVID.19)


# Renommer les colonnes APRÈS

colnames(data_latest) <- c("region", "Day", "total_cases")

#Vérifier

head(data_latest, 10)
nrow(data_latest)

# ÉTAPE 2 : CHARGER LA CARTE DU MONDE

world_map <- map_data("world")

```

```{r}
# Boutons de contrôle

fluidRow(
  column(4, actionButton("play", "▶️", class = "btn-success btn-block")),
  column(4, actionButton("pause", "⏸️", class = "btn-warning btn-block")),

)
br()

# Slider de date
sliderInput("date_slider",
            "📅 Date:",
            min = min(Covid19$Day),
            max = max(Covid19$Day),
            value = min(Covid19$Day),
            timeFormat = "%Y-%m-%d")
# Vitesse

           max = 30,
           value = 7)

           selected = "plasma")   

# Info du pays cliqué

h4("🎯 Pays sélectionné")
uiOutput("country_info")
```

### 📊 Statistiques du jour

```{r}

renderText({
  req(input$date_slider) 
  
  data <- Covid19 %>%
    filter(Day == input$date_slider) %>%
    mutate(total_cases = as.numeric(as.character(Total.confirmed.cases.of.COVID.19))) %>%  # Conversion!
    rename(region = Entity) %>%
    mutate(region = case_when(
      region == "United States" ~ "USA",
      region == "United Kingdom" ~ "UK",
      TRUE ~ region
    ))
  
  total_cases <- sum(data$total_cases, na.rm = TRUE)
  countries_with_cases <- sum(data$total_cases > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  most_affected <- if(total_cases > 0) {
    data$region[which.max(data$total_cases)]
  } else {
    "Aucun cas"
  }
  
  max_cases <- if(total_cases > 0) {
    format(max(data$total_cases, na.rm = TRUE), big.mark = " ")
  } else {
    "0"
  }
  
  paste0(
    "📅 Date: ", format(input$date_slider, "%d/%m/%Y"), "\n\n",
    "🌍 Cas mondiaux:\n",
    format(total_cases, big.mark = " "), "\n\n",
    "📍 Pays touchés: ", countries_with_cases, "\n\n",
    "🏆 Plus touché:\n",
    most_affected, "\n",
    "(", max_cases, " cas)"
  )
})

```

### Carte mondiale
```{r}

# ==========================================
# ANIMATION
# ==========================================

animation_active <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
clicked_country <- reactiveVal(NULL)  #Stocker le pays cliqué

observeEvent(input$play, { animation_active(TRUE) })
observeEvent(input$pause, { animation_active(FALSE) })
observeEvent(input$reset, {
  animation_active(FALSE)
  updateSliderInput(session, "date_slider", value = min(Covid19$Day))
})

autoInvalidate <- reactiveTimer(1000)
observe({
  autoInvalidate()
  if (animation_active()) {
    all_dates <- sort(unique(Covid19$Day))
    current_index <- which(all_dates == input$date_slider)
    next_index <- current_index + input$speed
    if (next_index > length(all_dates)) next_index <- 1
    updateSliderInput(session, "date_slider", value = all_dates[next_index])
  }
})

# ==========================================
# DONNÉES
# ==========================================

data_filtered <- reactive({
  req(input$date_slider)
  
  Covid19 %>%
    filter(Day == input$date_slider) %>%
    rename(region = Entity, total_cases = Total.confirmed.cases.of.COVID.19) %>%
    mutate(
      total_cases = as.numeric(as.character(total_cases)),
      region = case_when(
        region == "United States" ~ "USA",
        region == "United Kingdom" ~ "UK",
        region == "Democratic Republic of Congo" ~ "Democratic Republic of the Congo",
        region == "Congo" ~ "Republic of Congo",
        region == "Czechia" ~ "Czech Republic",
        region == "Timor" ~ "Timor-Leste",
        TRUE ~ region
      )
    )
})

map_data_day <- reactive({
  req(data_filtered())
  world_map %>% left_join(data_filtered(), by = "region")
})

# ==========================================
# GESTION DU CLIC 
# ==========================================

observeEvent(input$map_click, {
  click <- input$map_click
  map_data <- map_data_day()
  
  # Trouver le pays le plus proche du clic
  closest <- map_data %>%
    mutate(distance = sqrt((long - click$x)^2 + (lat - click$y)^2)) %>%
    filter(!is.na(region), distance == min(distance, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    slice(1)
  
  if(nrow(closest) > 0) {
    clicked_country(closest$region)
  }
})

# ==========================================
# CARTE AVEC SURBRILLANCE 
# ==========================================

plotOutput("world_map", height = "600px", click = "map_click")  # ← Ajout du click!

output$world_map <- renderPlot({
  req(map_data_day())
  map_data <- map_data_day()
  palette_choice <- input$color_palette
  if(is.null(palette_choice)) palette_choice <- "plasma"
  
  # Ajouter une colonne pour savoir quel pays est sélectionné
  if(!is.null(clicked_country())) {
    map_data <- map_data %>%
      mutate(selected = region == clicked_country())
  } else {
    map_data$selected <- FALSE
  }
  
  ggplot(map_data, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group)) +
    geom_polygon(aes(fill = total_cases),
                color = ifelse(map_data$selected, "red", "white"),  # ← Rouge si sélectionné!
                size = ifelse(map_data$selected, 2, 0.1)) +  # ← Plus épais si sélectionné!
    scale_fill_viridis(
      option = palette_choice,
      name = "Cas totaux",
      labels = scales::comma,
      trans = "sqrt",
      na.value = "grey90",
      limits = c(0, max(Covid19$Total.confirmed.cases.of.COVID.19, na.rm = TRUE))
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("📅 Carte Mondiale COVID-19 -", format(input$date_slider, "%d %B %Y")),
      subtitle = ifelse(!is.null(clicked_country()),
                       paste("🎯 Pays sélectionné:", clicked_country()),  # ← Afficher le pays!
                       " Cliquez sur un pays pour voir ses détails")
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0.5, 
                                   color = ifelse(!is.null(clicked_country()), "#e74c3c", "#7f8c8d")),
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.key.height = unit(2.5, "cm")
    ) +
    coord_fixed(1.3)
})
```




```{r}
output$country_info <- renderUI({
  if(is.null(clicked_country())) {
    wellPanel(
      style = "background-color: #f8f9fa; padding: 15px;",
      p("👆 Cliquez sur un pays", style = "text-align: center; color: #6c757d;")
    )
  } else {
    country_data <- data_filtered() %>%
      filter(region == clicked_country())
    
    if(nrow(country_data) > 0) {
      wellPanel(
        style = "background-color: #e3f2fd; padding: 15px;",
        h3(clicked_country(), style = "color: #1976d2; text-align: center; margin-top: 0;"),
        hr(),
        p(strong("📅 Date:"), format(input$date_slider, "%d/%m/%Y")),
        p(strong("🦠 Cas totaux:"), format(country_data$total_cases[1], big.mark = " ")),
        p(strong("📊 Rang mondial:"), 
          which(data_filtered() %>% arrange(desc(total_cases)) %>% pull(region) == clicked_country()))
      )
    }
  }
})
```

### 📈 Évolution du pays sélectionné
```{r}
library(plotly)

renderPlotly({
  # Si aucun pays cliqué
  
  if(is.null(clicked_country())) {
    return(
      plot_ly() %>%
        add_text(text = "👆 Cliquez sur un pays", 
                x = 0.5, y = 0.5, 
                textfont = list(size = 20, color = "gray")) %>%
        layout(xaxis = list(visible = FALSE),
               yaxis = list(visible = FALSE))
    )
  }
  
  # Trouver le nom original
  original_name <- clicked_country()
  
  if(clicked_country() == "USA") original_name <- "United States"
  if(clicked_country() == "UK") original_name <- "United Kingdom"
  if(clicked_country() == "Czech Republic") original_name <- "Czechia"
  
  # Récupérer les données
  history <- Covid19 %>%
    filter(Entity == original_name | Entity == clicked_country()) %>%
    arrange(Day) %>%
    mutate(Cases = as.numeric(as.character(Total.confirmed.cases.of.COVID.19)))
  
  # Si pas de données
  if(nrow(history) == 0) {
    return(
      plot_ly() %>%
        add_text(text = paste("Pas de données pour", clicked_country()), 
                x = 0.5, y = 0.5) %>%
        layout(xaxis = list(visible = FALSE),
               yaxis = list(visible = FALSE))
    )
  }
  
  # Créer le graphique avec plotly 
  
  plot_ly(history, x = ~Day, y = ~Cases, type = 'scatter', mode = 'lines',
          fill = 'tozeroy', fillcolor = 'rgba(52, 152, 219, 0.3)',
          line = list(color = 'rgb(41, 128, 185)', width = 2),
          hovertemplate = '<b>%{x|%d/%m/%Y}</b><br>Cas: %{y:,.0f}<extra></extra>') %>%
    add_trace(x = rep(input$date_slider, 2),
             y = c(0, max(history$Cases, na.rm = TRUE)),
             type = 'scatter', mode = 'lines',
             line = list(color = 'red', dash = 'dash', width = 2),
             showlegend = FALSE,
             hoverinfo = 'skip') %>%
    layout(
      title = list(text = paste("📈 Évolution -", clicked_country()), 
                  font = list(size = 16)),
      xaxis = list(title = "Date"),
      yaxis = list(title = "Cas cumulés", 
                  separatethousands = TRUE),
      hovermode = 'x unified',
      margin = list(t = 50)
    )
})
```
